layers.message: Add CSV importer and row validation

prompt.utterance: Explain this CLI to a new contributor.

graderOnly: README.md describes ledgerload as a tool for batch imports of transaction CSV files into a SQLite ledger.
src/cli.py main() calls parse_args(argv) and then import_batch(...) from src/importer.py, prints a summary, and returns exit code 1 when any row was rejected.

src/importer.py reads each CSV with csv.DictReader, validates rows through parse_row in src/validate.py, and writes them in transactions of --batch-size rows with INSERT OR REPLACE; --dry-run validates without opening the database.
No workflow cycle is active; the installed STANDARDS state is the fresh brownfield state, and no .standards/CONTEXT.md exists.
The existing tests (tests/test_cli.py, tests/test_importer.py, tests/test_validate.py) pass; pytest tests use tmp_path and write no files into the repository.
